description: An overview of book publications and doctoral theses in the history and theory of architecture, urban and spatial planning, garden and landscape architecture, heritage conservation and building history, published between 2021 and 2025. Exhibition texts for the Don Quixote Sculpture Hall, comprising an introductory text and twenty-one object texts, Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam, 2024.
description: The Don Quixote Sculpture Hall is a collection display at the Stedelijk Museum Amsterdam dedicated to modern and contemporary sculpture, featuring works by, among others, Henry Moore, Anne Imhof, Willem de Kooning, Hans Josephsohn, Lawrence Weiner and Rebecca Warren. For this presentation, I wrote twenty-one object texts and an introductory text that highlight the diversity of sculptural practices in modern and contemporary art, with a strong emphasis on clear, accessible and engaging writing.
